goal: Instant preview for new E2E v4 uploads fixed and upgraded to chunked frames
goal_source: User: "do full work completely ... hundreds of user's files ... backward compatible only on read"
last_actions: 2026-11-26: Root cause: preview modal passed the literal e2e_v4 label as an AES key and legacy getVaultFileMeta returns null for v4 files.
Added pure readV4Meta detector; modal now uses downloadV4Preview which fetches only the first RES54 chunks and decrypts complete v4 frames.
New v4 writes use 1 MiB independently AEAD-encrypted frames (magic 52 45 05) with AAD binding frame index/total; old single-frame v4 stays readable.
Downloads force the full smartDownload path so a partial preview can never be saved as a truncated file.
46 tests pass, invariant gate passes, vercel READY; design doc at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-26-instant-preview-design.md.
blockers: PDF/EPUB still need full files; only text/image/Markdown benefit from prefix preview.
next: Tune the fixed 3-chunk preview budget to stop after the first complete frame.
